## src/content

- [src/content/cluster.js](src/content/cluster.js): window.StickySites.Cluster: floating pill with identity icons, drag, long-press reorder, layout toggle, visibility (maintained source)
- [src/content/crypto-content.js](src/content/crypto-content.js): window.StickySites.Crypto: PBKDF2 + AES-256-GCM, envelope detection, enable/unlock/disable, cached key in chrome.storage.local (maintained source)
- [src/content/mentions.js](src/content/mentions.js): window.StickySites.Mentions: @-mention autocomplete dropdown (link, date, contact, file) inserting chips at the caret (maintained source)
- [src/content/note-types.js](src/content/note-types.js): window.StickySites.noteTypes: six note-type descriptors with storage keys, key/label/placeholder and identity-icon functions (maintained source)
- [src/content/outline-ops.js](src/content/outline-ops.js): window.StickySites.OutlineOps: pure outline tree operations, filter, auto-group, Markdown/OPML export (unit-tested) (maintained source)
- [src/content/outline.js](src/content/outline.js): window.StickySites.Outline: outliner UI over a global library of named docs; switcher, menu, keyboard nav, zoom, filter, lock notice (maintained source)
- [src/content/panel.js](src/content/panel.js): window.StickySites.Panel: moveable/resizable note panel, 19-tool rich-text toolbar, find & replace, to-do UI, debounced encrypted save, cross-tab sync, popout (maintained source)
- [src/content/prefs.js](src/content/prefs.js): window.StickySites.Prefs: read/write stickysites_prefs_v1 with defaults (maintained source)
- [src/content/safe-html.js](src/content/safe-html.js): Inert rich-text allowlist sanitizer and block-aware plain-text extraction. (maintained source)
- [src/content/sticky-inject.css](src/content/sticky-inject.css): All injected styles for cluster, panel, toolbar, to-do, outliner, mentions, lock overlay, toast (also used by popout.html) (maintained source)
- [src/content/sticky-inject.js](src/content/sticky-inject.js): Orchestrator content script: init, lock overlay, toast, clip handler, Ctrl/Cmd+F1-F6, SPA URL watcher, message and storage listeners (maintained source)
- [src/content/storage-content.js](src/content/storage-content.js): Classic-script IPC client for the authoritative service-worker writer. (maintained source)
- [src/content/todo.js](src/content/todo.js): window.StickySites.Todo: to-do item/section normalisation, color palettes, grip drag-reorder controller (maintained source)
